title.label: When it works it works, when it doesn’t it doesn’t

content.label:
When it’s working it’s probably the best dictation tool. Unfortunately even though I’m pro I tap the mic and it says “time to upgrade”. I sign out, sign in, nope. Quite all apps, nope.

Wouldn’t leave this review if there was a support system in the app. I’m not going to hunt down your emails. If you’re charging customers, put support in the app.
